description: This file defines a configuration class ShopizerClientsProperties for managing downstream service client properties such as base URLs and timeouts, used within the checkout-service module of the project. It uses Spring Boot annotations for configuration and validation.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties
classes.description: Contains configuration properties for various downstream clients such as cart, order, pricing, tax, and promotions.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties.ServiceClientProperties
classes.description: Holds individual service client settings including base URL and timeout value.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Returns the ServiceClientProperties instance for cart service.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the ServiceClientProperties instance for order service.

methods.name: getPricing
methods.description: Returns the ServiceClientProperties instance for pricing service.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the ServiceClientProperties instance for tax service.

methods.name: getPromotions
methods.description: Returns the ServiceClientProperties instance for promotions service.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Gets the base URL for the service client.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Sets the base URL for the service client.

methods.name: getTimeoutMs
methods.description: Gets the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.

methods.name: setTimeoutMs
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.
